pages.title: Conversations
pages.purpose: Chats first: every conversation on the connected server in one list (Needs you, Today, Earlier), the project a small label on each row and a filter chip. Reads ChatFeedSource only.

elements.label: All projects | <project name>
elements.effect: Opens the project filter sheet.

elements.label: Needs you · {count}
elements.effect: Toggles the Needs you filter; with Running also on, either matches.

elements.label: Running
elements.effect: Toggles the Running filter.

elements.label: <project> · <title> · <state or time> · <last line>
elements.effect: Rescopes the connection to the conversation's project and opens it.

elements.label: New conversation
elements.effect: Opens the start screen on the filtered or last used project.

elements.label: Clear filters
elements.effect: Removes the project and status filters.

elements.label: Start a conversation in <project>
elements.effect: Opens the start screen on the filtered project.
gates: the chosen project has no conversations

elements.label: Start a conversation
elements.effect: Opens the start screen on the last used project.

pages.title: Show conversations from
pages.purpose: The project filter: All projects with the total, each project with its counts and Git badge, and Open a project. One sheet; Open a project closes it before the folder browser opens.

elements.label: All projects
elements.effect: Clears the project filter.

elements.label: <project> · n conversations · m running · needs you
elements.effect: Filters to that project.

elements.label: Open a project…
elements.effect: Closes this sheet, opens the Open a project sheet; the chosen folder becomes the filter.

pages.title: Connections in this list
pages.purpose: Which connections' conversations the list shows: one switch per saved OpenCode server and the agents on this phone. The connection the app is on is always shown; servers elsewhere stay off until turned on.

elements.label: <server or agents> · New conversations start here | On this phone | On another computer | Agents on this phone
elements.effect: Shows or hides that connection's conversations in the list; a hidden server's connection closes.

pages.title: New conversation
pages.purpose: What should we work on? A project chip and the composer. Send starts the conversation in the chosen project and replaces this screen with it.

elements.label: <project> | Choose a project
elements.effect: Opens the Open a project sheet; its choice updates the chip.

elements.label: Send
elements.effect: startChatIn(directory, firstPrompt); on failure says why in plain words and keeps the draft.

elements.label: Repair
elements.effect: In Retry's place when the project's Git can't be read: opens Repair Git history.
gates: start failed with projectGit on this phone's built-in Ubuntu

pages.title: Import from Claude Code
pages.purpose: Lists the Claude Code conversations started on the computer in this project, newest first (title or first prompt, folder, when); a tap imports one and opens it.

elements.label: <title> · <folder> · <when>
elements.effect: Imports the conversation, then closes and opens it.

pages.title: Repair Git history
pages.purpose: Repairs a project whose Git objects are links Git can't follow (from Termux's Ubuntu, or a moved folder): runs at once with its progress, then says what happened. Repaired: Start the conversation sends the kept message. Files in Termux: Allow and repair, or Repair again and Open Termux. Files gone: how many, and to clone again or restore a copy. Technical text under Details.
gates: Android, built-in Ubuntu, project under /root/projects, start failed with projectGit

elements.label: Start the conversation
elements.effect: Closes the sheet; New conversation sends the message again.

elements.label: Allow and repair
elements.effect: Asks Android for Termux's Run commands permission, then repairs again.
gates: files in Termux, permission not given

elements.label: Repair again
elements.effect: Runs the repair again.

elements.label: Open Termux
elements.effect: Opens the Termux app so it starts.

elements.label: Close
elements.effect: Closes the sheet; the message stays in the field.

pages.title: Inbox
pages.purpose: Everything that waits on the person across connections, oldest first, cleared top to bottom: permission asks answer in place (Allow once / Reject with the exact command), everything else opens its chat.

reachedFrom.trigger: notifications, the Quick Settings tile, the widgets and Search's Go to

elements.label: {permission ask}
elements.effect: Allow once / Reject with Undo; the card names the exact command.

elements.label: {conversation}
elements.effect: Opens the conversation that waits.

elements.label: {watched server request}
elements.effect: Opens the server the request is on.

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: Reads an unreachable source again.

notPages.reason: No surface: the one seam between the Chats screens and the connection (feed source, server pill, opening a conversation, model chip).
Data only: the InboxEntry kinds the Inbox page (lib/ui/screens/inbox/inbox_screen.dart, page inbox) lists; no surface or control of its own.
Data only: HomeOpening, the last conversation titles, status and tone the home shows read-only while the saved server is still connecting on a cold start; no surface of its own.

notes: Chats home speaks 'conversation' because the glossary (test/ui_glossary_test.dart) bans 'chat' in copy; the approved mockup says Chats.
